title: SessionRewindUndonePayload

toMessageId.description: The user message the undone rewind went back to; it and the items the rewind hid are shown again.

rewindSequence.description: The sequence of the session.rewound this undoes: the session's latest rewind not already undone.

description: session.rewind-undone: a rewind was taken back (sessions.undoRewind, ADR 0022) before any run started on the session after it; the items it hid are shown again, and the next run continues the provider session as it was before the rewind, or from an earlier rewind still standing.
